title: DRAGON AUDITED CHESTS
description: Mystery chests now show exact odds, duplicate rules, pity distance, and maximum spend under the supervision of a tiny contract dragon wearing half-moon spectacles.
consequence: The loot box gets a notary with wings.

title: NO AMBUSH STORE DOOR
description: Bonfire shops now stop opening surprise offers after deaths, boss wins, and suspiciously emotional cutscenes, waiting instead behind one honest menu prompt.
consequence: The store stops hiding behind the fog wall.

title: LAST-LAP MERCY TOKEN
description: Final-lap crashes now pause just long enough to offer a premium rewind token, complete with pit crew sympathy, heroic tire smoke, and a countdown that breathes too close.
consequence: The finish line starts selling alibis.

title: IMMERSIVE HAGGLE PRICES
description: Merchants now rewrite prices through faction mood, local taxes, hero reputation, moon weather, and regional bargaining folklore before showing the same sword twice.
consequence: The merchant invents folklore for the receipt.
